definitions.definition: Access to a resource for a period of time, generally for payment.

quote.citation: 1951 April, “Preservation of the Talyllyn Railway”, in Railway Magazine, number 600, page 218:
quote.text: The Society, which is a non-profit-making organisation, is inviting enthusiasts to become members at a minimum annual subscription of £1.

quote.citation: 1967, “When the Music’s Over”, in Strange Days, performed by The Doors:
quote.text: Cancel my subscription to the Resurrection / Send my credentials to the House of Detention / I got some friends inside

definitions.definition: The formal acceptance of something, especially when verified with a signature.
Contributing or promising to contribute money to a common fund.
